late.sh is 18+ ~ house rules at late.sh/terms, reports to admin@dwarfforge.io
Try our games! ~Rank up on the leaderboards, page 6~
Water your bonsai once a day with the w key
You can open a public room with /public #room
Switch what you hear: v then x cycles audio sources, v then 1-4 picks a stream or station
Copy a track to your clipboard: ctrl+y in the Music Booth (v then v) or Stations (v then r)
Keep up to 20 favorite tracks on top of the Music Booth History: f on a History row
Configure your notification preferences: ctrl+o
Press ? outside of chat to see help
Press tab to cycle through chat, games, and art
You can /ignore and /unignore @users
Try out blackjack, poker, and chess!!
Ctrl+G then c posts a chess960 challenge: same chess, shuffled back rank, castle by moving your king onto your own rook
Press Control+] to open the emoji and symbol picker
Press 2 for minigames, 3 for games, 4 for artboard, 5 for profiles
Type /binds in chat for a list of available chat commands
You can change your username in ctrl+o settings
Connect from an IRC client with a token from ctrl+o settings
Music is available through web streaming and CLI
You can start a DM with someone by typing /dm @username
Look for instructions on how to tune in to the music...
Type /active in chat to see who is online
Use /members to see who's in the current room
Select a chat message with j/k and press r to reply to it
Solve a daily puzzle every day to build a streak and earn chip rewards
Earn chips by solving daily puzzles and quests (page 2)
Share a web link in the special 'news' chatroom
Press s on a News story to save it for later: saved stories sit on their own shelf above the feed
Install and use Nerd Fonts for the best experience!
Check in on your pet with /pet feed and /pet water
Try a different color theme in ctrl+o settings
Your bonsai grows slow and steady, water it daily for the best results
The music keeps playing even when you're not chatting!
Resize your terminal and the layout reflows automatically
You land in the Clubhouse: walk with hjkl, press i to talk, w to wave, x to dance
In the Clubhouse your words float over your head; the full chat lives on Home (1)
Walk up to the Clubhouse dog and press Enter. Everyone sees the pet
Press n in the Clubhouse for Nightcap, the quiet bar out back: take a stool to talk
Press ` on Home or Zen to hop through games waiting on you: your-move boards, seated tables, unfinished daily puzzles, live door games
Type /search in chat to find old messages across all your rooms
Made a private room? /roominfo sets what it is about and its rules
Lost in Lateania? Press m for the overhead map: it fills in only where you have walked
Defend the Gate in CodeKeep: open Games (3), select CodeKeep, and press Enter
On cyberspace.online too? Link your account and post from here: /cs link
Their chat rooms work from here as well: /cs chat, then Enter to add one to your rail
Chat in another language? Press t on a message to translate it, or set a language in ctrl+o settings
Press g on someone else's message to gild it: three tiers, chips to the author, a permanent marker on the message
Sliding Puzzle in the Arcade: press i to swap numbered tiles for the picture, same board, same chips
Wondering who else cracked today's Sudoku? Press o on any daily card in the Arcade
Le Word in the Arcade is one five-letter word a day, the same for everyone: six guesses, then s shares your grid
Rubik's Cube in the Arcade scrambles the same cube for everyone each UTC day; v and the arrows turn the view, not the cube
Nonograms in the Arcade never need a guess: line logic alone finishes every one
Minesweeper in the Arcade gives every board three lives, and when it ends your flags turn green or red
Solitaire in the Arcade deals a draw-1 and a draw-3 game each UTC day; land the last card for the classic cascade
Proud of your Artboard work? On page 4 pick Hang a piece in the rail and frame it
On the Artboard press i, then paste ASCII art: it floats at your cursor until Enter stamps it, Esc drops it
Artboard's NSFW disclaimer: V views this visit, A always views on this device, B returns to chat; Ctrl+O > Tweaks sets it per device
Press A (Always View) on the Artboard disclaimer and this splash shows the day's gallery piece
Pool in the Lobby: ' picks the ball that's on, a aims, e sets spin, then s and stroke the mouse down and up
Pool's cue panel is the shot: click the target ball to aim, the cue ball to set spin, the cue itself to stroke
Pool: h and l turn the cue a degree, { and } step through the pots on offer, and the line shows where every ball ends up
Daily snooker is the full frame on a 12ft table: reds and colours, free balls, and 700 chips to whoever is ahead at the end
A game somebody just moved in heads #lounge for a while; click the board to watch
Press 7 for the events board: anyone can post one, and i says I'm in
Posting an event? Type movie night saturday 9pm as the title and the time fills itself in
An hour before a board event starts it heads the now strip on Home; o opens it
One world, everyone on it: the Realm lives on page 3, under the house
The Realm's gates are open while under half the world is claimed ~ j on the map takes your spot
Where is everyone? /map shades the Earth by who is online where ~ Ctrl+O sets your country so you are on it
Who is hiring: /jobs opens the job feed ~ s searches it, / keeps the postings that carry your tags
Looking for someone? Page 5, ] to Profiles, then s searches names, cards and projects
Netwalk in the Arcade: turn tiles until the network lights every one ~ f locks a tile you are sure of
